newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Tellus 1996 reports net loss.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Tellus 1996 reports net loss.

text.p: Shenzhen Tellus Holdings Co Ltd had a net loss of 165.70 million yuan for 1996, the Shenzhen stock exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Tuesday.
Losses per share were 0.75 yuan and turnover reached 436.0 million yuan in 1996.
It did not say whether the figures were based on Chinese or international accounting standards, or give comparative figures.
In 1995, the company lost 20.36 million yuan under international standards.
The company proposed no dividend for 1996, the exchange said.
Trading in Tellus A and B shares will be suspended Wednesday morning and will resume in the afternoon.
